action.action-desc: Mr. Soto introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to clarify the definition of a broker, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Cryptocurrency Tax Clarity Act.

section.header: Information reporting for brokers and digital assets

subsection.text: Section 6045(c)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking and at the end of subparagraph (B),

subparagraph.text: by striking any other person who (for a consideration) and inserting any person who (for consideration), and
by striking the period at the end and inserting , and, and

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: any person who (for consideration) regularly effectuates transfers of digital assets on behalf of another person.

Section 6045(g)(3)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking and at the end of clause (iii), by redesignating clause (iv) as clause (v), and by inserting after clause (iii) the following new clause:
Section 6045(g)(3) of such Code is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

Except as otherwise provided by the Secretary, the term digital asset means any digital representation of value which is recorded on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger or any similar technology as specified by the Secretary.
Section 6045(g)(3)(C) of such Code is amended—

clause.text: in clause (ii), by striking and at the end,
by redesignating clause (iii) as clause (iv), and
by inserting after clause (iii) the following:
January 1, 2023, in the case of any specified security which is a digital asset, and

subparagraph.text: Section 6045A of such Code is amended—

clause.text: in subsection (a), by striking a security which is, and
by adding at the end the following:

subsection.header: Return requirement for certain transfers of digital assets not otherwise subject to reporting
subsection.text: Any broker, with respect to any transfer (which is not part of a sale or exchange executed by such broker) during a calendar year of a covered security which is a digital asset from an account maintained by such broker to an account which is not maintained by, or an address not associated with, a person that such broker knows or has reason to know is also a broker, shall make a return for such calendar year, in such form as determined by the Secretary, showing the information otherwise required to be furnished with respect to transfers subject to subsection (a).

subparagraph.text: Section 6724(d)(1)(B) of such Code is amended by striking or at the end of clause (xxv), by striking and at the end of clause (xxvi), and by inserting after clause (xxvi) the following new clause:

clause.text: section 6045A(d) (relating to returns for certain digital assets),

subparagraph.header: Treatment as cash for purposes of section 6050I
subparagraph.text: Section 6050I(d) of such Code is amended by striking and at the end of paragraph (1), by striking the period at the end of paragraph (2) and inserting , and, and by inserting after paragraph (2) the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: any digital asset (as defined in section 6045(g)(3)(D).

subsection.text: The amendments made by this section shall apply to returns required to be filed, and statements required to be furnished, after December 31, 2023.

paragraph.text: Nothing in this section or the amendments made by this section shall be construed to create any inference that a person described in section 6045(c)(1)(D) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as added by this section, includes any person solely engaged in the business of—

subparagraph.text: validating distributed ledger transactions, without providing other functions or services, or
selling hardware or software for which the sole function is to permit persons to control private keys which are used for accessing digital assets on a distributed ledger.

paragraph.header: Brokers and treatment of digital assets
paragraph.text: Nothing in this section or the amendments made by this section shall be construed to create any inference, for any period prior to the effective date of such amendments, with respect to—

subparagraph.text: whether any person is a broker under section 6045(c)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, or
whether any digital asset is property which is a specified security under section 6045(g)(3)(B) of such Code.
